# appgatesdp_blacklist_user (Resource)

Supported SDP Admin API versions: v21, v22, v23, v24, v25.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "appgatesdp_blacklist_user" "alice" {
  user_distinguished_name = "CN=alice,OU=ldap"
  reason                  = "Device reported lost"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `user_distinguished_name` (String) Distinguished name of a user. Format: "CN=,OU="

### Optional

- `provider_name` (String) The provider name of the user, same as the one in the user Distinguished Name.
- `reason` (String) The reason for blacklisting. The value is stored and logged.
- `username` (String) The username, same as the one in the user Distinguished Name.

### Read-Only

- `blacklisted_at` (String) The date and time of the blacklisting.
- `id` (String) ID of the object.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Blacklist entries are imported by user distinguished name.
terraform import appgatesdp_blacklist_user.alice "CN=alice,OU=ldap"
```
